content.title: Tattoo BOGO | Chipotle Mexican Grill
content.text: What is Tatted Like A Chipotle Bag? Inspired by the iconic scribbles on our bags and the legends who wear their ink proudly, Tatted Like A Chipotle Bag is our Friday the 13th BOGO (Buy-One-Get-One) entrée tradition. It’s a day known for flash tattoos—and now, flash burritos. What time will the promo be available? The BOGO Free Entrée will only be available in Chipotle restaurants on Friday, March 13th from 3:00–4:00 PM local time. Yes, one hour only, so don’t be late. Where will this promo be available? The BOGO will be available in the US and Canada and in-restaurant only (not online), so you can proudly show off your tattoos in person. What type of tattoos count? Any and all types — Real, temporary, freshly Sharpied or any other creative iteration. If you’re tatted, you earned yourself a Buy-One-Get-One Free Entrée. Do I need to be a Rewards member? Not at all. This flash Tattoo BOGO is open to all guests who show up inked, in some shape or form. But Rewards members who scan in-restaurant at checkout will unlock an exclusive Friday the 13th Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag badge in the app. Is it true Chipotle is collaborating with Swae Lee? The rumors are true. We’re teaming up with Swae Lee—the voice behind the viral Mannequin Challenge—for a throwback moment that makes 2026 feel like 2016 again. Check out our social page www.instagram.com/chipotle for more information.
